quote: If the robots.txt file is undefined for a reasonably long period of time (for example, 30 days), crawlers MAY assume that the robots.txt file is unavailable
undefined for a reasonably long period of time (for example, 30 days), crawlers MAY assume that the robots.txt file is unavailable as defined in Section 2.3.1.3 or continue to use a cached copy.
If a robots.txt file is reached within five consecutive redirects, the robots.txt file MUST be fetched, parsed, and its rules followed
The parsing limit MUST be at least 500 kibibytes [KiB].
